name: negative-typed-allow-true
description: A typed negative over an unreal field with Allow negative real values on as File > Preferences writes it ([Object Editor] Allow Negative Values=true, through we.prefs; 2026-11-20): negative-reals.w3x (make-negative-reals.mjs), Object Editor (F6), Abilities, the custom Heal A000 (End, Right), the field list's End, a double-click on Level 1 - Stats - Cast Range (350.000, 380,383), 'Edit Ability Value - Real', Ctrl+A, -7, Return: the editor shows and saves 0.000, as Studio's Object Editor does with its setting off (objectedit.ts clampsToZero). So the preference changes nothing here either (misc checks 4 (4) saw the same with =1). Studio with objectEditor.allowNegativeReals on keeps the -7 (not this spec)

steps.eval: await w3.commands.execute('w3.objectEditor.open', 'w3a', 'A000'); for (let i = 0; i < 300 && document.querySelectorAll('.obj-table .obj-value-cell').length < 20; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); const s = document.querySelector('input.obj-field-search'); s.value = 'aran'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); for (let i = 0; i < 50 && document.querySelectorAll('.obj-table .obj-value-cell input:not(.color-tools-picker)').length !== 3; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); const inp = document.querySelector('.obj-table .obj-value-cell input:not(.color-tools-picker)'); inp.value = '-7'; inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1000)); await w3.editors.saveAll();

name: oe-typed-past-max
description: Numbers typed past a field's maxVal in the Object Editor (negative-reals.w3x's custom Heal A000; 2026-11-20): Level 1 - Stats - Mana Cost (int, maxVal 1000) typed 5000, Level 3 - Cooldown (unreal, 3600) 9999, Level 2 - Cast Range (unreal, 99999) 123456, each through its 'Edit Ability Value' dialog, Ctrl+A, the number, Return: the editor saves 1000, 3600 and 99999, its maxVal, without a word. Studio saves what was typed and notes the range in the field's tooltip (lib/objects/limits.ts: the game's own maps go past the ranges): the expected difference, by path, until that is decided

steps.eval: await w3.commands.execute('w3.objectEditor.open', 'w3a', 'A000'); for (let i = 0; i < 300 && document.querySelectorAll('.obj-table .obj-value-cell').length < 20; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); const type = async (field, nth, value) => { const s = document.querySelector('input.obj-field-search'); s.value = field; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); const inputs = () => document.querySelectorAll('.obj-table .obj-value-cell input:not(.color-tools-picker)'); for (let i = 0; i < 50 && inputs().length !== 3; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); const inp = inputs()[nth]; inp.value = value; inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); }; await type('amcs', 0, '5000'); await type('acdn', 2, '9999'); await type('aran', 1, '123456'); await w3.editors.saveAll();
